entities.name: Sardian Mountains
entities.description: A metal- and stone-rich range on Terisiare peopled by human clans, dwarves, goblins and minotaurs; later the Karplusan Mountains.

entities.name: Kathwar
entities.description: Chief of the Malpiri clan, invited to join the Union of the Third Path.

entities.name: Union of the Third Path
entities.description: Union Kathwar was invited to join.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Traded with Sardian dwarves to fuel his war effort.

entities.name: Dwarves of Sardia
entities.description: Dwarves who traded with Urza and reported burning rains.

entities.name: Storgard
entities.description: Nation built in the western ranges.

entities.name: Tanglewoods
entities.description: Woods that grew north of Storgard.

events.summary: The Archmandrite invites Kathwar to join the Union of the Third Path.
Urza trades with the Sardian dwarves to fuel his war effort.
events.quote: Urza traded with the dwarves of Sardia to fuel his war effort

events.summary: Late in the war, Sardian dwarves report burning rains falling from the sky.
events.quote: burning rains were falling from the sky into their land

events.summary: After the war the range becomes enveloped in ice and Storgard is built in the west.
events.quote: The nation of Storgard was built in the western ranges

relations.quote: Urza traded with the dwarves of Sardia
